title: Cover before you test
hook: Seeing the answer and retrieving it are different activities.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: Perform a closed-answer check before using feedback.

objective: Perform a closed-answer check before using feedback.

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: Seeing the answer and retrieving it are different activities. Which check asks you to retrieve an answer? Correct option: Answer covered. All fixture labels, example words, dates, task durations and file fields are stipulated exercise data.
claims.source: Explicit exercise fixture in src/lib/lifehacks/studyCatalog.ts and pure rules in studyModels.ts. All times, sizes, deadlines and outcomes describe this exercise only; no empirical productivity or learning effect is inferred. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md.

claims.text: Covering the answer removes the direct reading route. This reconstruction records one attempt, not a long-term memory score.
claims.source: Roediger & Karpicke (2006), Test-Enhanced Learning, Psychological Science 17(3),249–255, DOI10.1111/j.1467-9280.2006.01693.x; publisher abstract retrieved 2026-10-13: https://www.psychologicalscience.org/journals/psychological-science/j.1467-9280.2006.01693.x/ . Prose-passage experiments found delayed retention advantages for retrieval over restudy. This short exercise does not establish that effect for the learner. Fixture mappings and rules are explicit conventions, not empirical demonstrations. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md.

claims.text: Every displayed result is computed from the visible exercise state: recall. One short reconstruction; not a retention experiment. The reveal reports this same state and never translates its score into a personal productivity or memory benefit.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/studyModels.ts and src/components/lifehacks/StudyLesson.tsx, cover-before-recall fixture in src/lib/lifehacks/studyCatalog.ts. Stage rules: check reconstructed token positions against the covered target; count exact matches out of three. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md.

claims.text: Hiding the answer removes the reading route, so you have to produce it; rereading and recognising still show it to you.

recall.question: You want to check that you know the Spanish words on a two-column list. Which check makes you retrieve each word?
options: Read down both columns slowly, twice
Fold over the Spanish column, then say each word
Tick each Spanish word you recognise on sight
recall.why: Hiding the answer removes the reading route, so you have to produce it; rereading and recognising still show it to you.
